results.title: Aanandham Sadha Neetho
results.overview: The story follows Nani and Keerthy, whose funny first meeting slowly develops into love. Keerthy painful past makes her insecure and afraid that Nani may change or leave her. Nani understands her fears and tries to give her trust, patience, and emotional security. The story’s main message is that relationships may have problems, but love, communication, and willingness to change can help “repair” them.

results.title: Mahendragiri Varahi
results.overview: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

results.title: Maremma
results.overview: In a village bound by ancient traditions, the Maremma Goddess festival is a time of both reverence and fear. Every 12 years, a male bull is sacrificed to the deity, yet with each ceremony, calamity befalls the villagers. Despite their efforts, the elders fail to prevent disaster. Determined to break the cycle, they enact a new decree: any household whose bull bears a male calf in the next 100 days must offer it to the goddess. As the deadline approaches, the fate of the village hangs in the balance, and the true test of their resolve begins.

results.title: Epic - First Semester
results.overview: Rohan, a middle-class student studying abroad due to family expectations, explores romance, identity, and growing up with honesty and emotional depth.

results.title: Aham Brahmasmi?
results.overview: After his faith is shattered by the senseless murder of a starving child, a disillusioned devotee sets out to find the ending to a cryptic childhood story, ultimately discovering that the divine savior he has been searching for is actually closer than he thinks.

results.title: Sahaa - Life of Sanju
results.overview: Sanju's journey from childhood to adulthood takes an emotional turn when he meets a young woman named Sahaa, whose presence awakens nostalgic memories from his past.

results.title: Romanchakam
results.overview: A cocky engineering grad starts a dating app to prove he can succeed at anything. But a mysterious online connection turns his world upside down. Between a failed startup, money trouble, and crazy moments with his friends, things get messy when a strange encounter hints at something darker. What starts as a desperate chase for a girl becomes a tough journey inward--where he learns the hardest person to understand isn't someone else, but himself.

results.title: Sithilam
results.overview: A 15 year old lie resurfaces as a YouTuber is suddenly interested in a closed case of serial killings, doubting the testimony of the sole survivor of that murderer.

results.title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
results.overview: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

results.title: The Red Bag
results.overview: Four women trapped in a deadly human-trafficking empire steal a mysterious red bag and race through betrayal, violence, and relentless pursuit, only to discover the bag holds a secret powerful enough to change everything.

results.title: Ameer Log
results.overview: Three carefree friends from a bustling Hyderabad basti spend their days wandering narrow lanes, sharing plates of biryani, and dreaming of a better life. When an old cook's secret recipe brings unexpected success their way, they must choose between fleeting fame and the enduring value of friendship, memories, and the taste of home.

results.title: Sanjeev
results.overview: Sanjeev, a young aspiring actor from rural Telangana, and debut director Shiva struggle against powerful obstacles, with Sanjeev's financial crisis threatening their shared dream of making a film.

results.title: Irumudi
results.overview: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

results.title: Forest Guard
results.overview: A secret reunion deep in the forest takes a dangerous turn when hidden agendas and betrayal turn Mithun's night into a fight for survival. But who can he really trust?

results.title: Hushar Pittalu
results.overview: In a village, two teenagers, Ravi and Chitti, are drawn into a secret relationship as curiosity, adolescence, and bad influences shape their choices. When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

results.title: Pallaburusu
results.overview: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

results.title: Agadha
results.overview: A solitary girl encounters a towering twelve-handed mystical idol in a torch lit shadowy cave, creating an atmosphere of spirituality and dark intrigue.

results.title: Yamudu
results.overview: Yamudu follows Lord Yama's descent to earth to unleash brutal Garuda Purana punishments on the guilty. A police investigation and intertwining fates build toward a shocking revelation about who Yama truly is and the trauma behind his wrath.
